title: Split System Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Install one Daikin Cora 7.1kW split system unit (model FTXF71TV1B/RXF71TV1B) in the living room of a residential property in Campbelltown, NSW. Supply and install one wall mounting bracket for the outdoor unit. Run six metres of refrigerant copper piping and nine metres of electrical cable from the outdoor unit, situated on the ground, to the indoor unit, with a new external electrical isolator mounted adjacent to the outdoor unit. Install six metres of gravity-fed drain pipe. Include three metres of slimline PVC pipe cover/ducting in a cream finish. Commission the system and provide a compliance certificate.
workingDetail: Indoor and outdoor split system unit, Wall mounting bracket, Refrigerant copper piping, Electrical cable and isolator
